RockBLOCK 9704

RockBLOCK 9704 gives developers reliable global satellite connectivity, combining the Iridium Certus 9704 module with onboard power regulation, USB-C and TTL UART interfaces, optional GNSS passthrough, open-source C and Python libraries, and Cloudloop Data integration.

Key Capabilities

Built for fast prototyping and straightforward integration, RockBLOCK 9704 supports larger satellite messages, low power operation and reliable two way communication anywhere on Earth with a clear view of the sky.

Messages up to 100 KB for richer data transfer

Latency as low as 10 seconds end to end

Global Iridium coverage for remote deployments

Low power operation for battery deployments

USB-C and TTL UART for easy integration

Move from Prototype to Production

RockBLOCK 9704 is supported by open source C and Python libraries, with tutorials and example code to help developers integrate it quickly.

The libraries handle JSPR command sequencing, session and power mode management, message fragmentation and reassembly, and flow control. Configure the serial port, then use simple send and receive functions without implementing the underlying Iridium protocol yourself.

From Remote Device to Application

Once messages leave the device, Cloudloop Data seamlessly routes uplinks and downlinks to your HTTPS or MQTT endpoint, and exposes a REST API and dashboard for device metadata, transmission status, and message history.

With flexible, pay-per-message billing and real time usage dashboards, Ground Control delivers true full stack support, from hardware and network transport through to data delivery, so you can prototype fast and scale instantly.

Use Cases

RockBLOCK 9704 supports applications that need to exchange more than basic tracking or status data without the power demands of a continuous satellite IP connection.

UAV Backup Comms

Provide a secondary communications path for telemetry, status updates and important commands when cellular or radio links are unavailable.

USV and Buoy Telemetry

Send position, sensor readings and mission data from autonomous vessels, drifting buoys and other offshore platforms operating beyond terrestrial coverage.

Environmental Monitoring

Return larger sensor datasets from weather stations, hydrology systems, scientific instruments and monitoring equipment in isolated locations.

Mobile Asset Telemetry

Transmit location, operating status and diagnostic information from vehicles, machinery and other assets moving through areas with limited terrestrial connectivity.

Scientific Instrumentation

Retrieve measurements, logs and diagnostic data from equipment deployed in difficult or expensive to access environments.

Product Development

Add Iridium IMT connectivity to a prototype quickly, then use the same core hardware, libraries and platform services as the application moves toward production.

Technical Essentials

Key integration details covering message capacity, power, interfaces, antenna options and physical fit.

Messages can arrive in under 10 seconds under optimal conditions.

Compact PCB for Embedded Integration

Choose a 48 × 52 mm SMA board or a 72 × 72 mm patch version.

Integrated or External Antenna

Choose an onboard patch or qualified antenna for the SMA version.

DC, Battery or USB-C Power

Accepts 4.0-5.3 V DC, 3.6-4.5 V battery input, or 5 V USB-C.

Under 5 mW in Sleep Mode

Uses around 60 mW when idle and approximately 1.4 W while transmitting.

TTL UART and USB-C Serial

Connect using 3.3 V TTL UART or the FTDI USB-C serial interface.

Developer Support

RockBLOCK 9704 is supported by open source C and Python libraries, with tutorials, example code and full developer documentation to help with integration. The libraries handle the underlying JSPR command flow, session management, message fragmentation and reassembly, so developers do not need to build those functions from scratch.

Cloudloop Data manages message delivery between deployed devices and cloud applications. Data can be routed to HTTPS or MQTT endpoints, while the REST API provides access to device, message and delivery information. Prepaid and contract airtime options are available, with usage and billing managed through Cloudloop.

FAQs

No, the 9704 uses a proprietary protocol which Iridium call JSPR (JSON-Based Serial Protocol for REST). It’s a little more complicated than an AT style interface, and requires you to exchange JSON documents with the module. Due to the limited on-board memory, when sending large messages, there are some quite strict timing rules too.

All of this complexity is handled elegantly by our open source C library, so in practice we don’t expect people to implement the JSPR protocol themselves, and will instead use our library in their projects.

That said, the RockBLOCK Pro and Pro OEM devices expose an AT command interface that is largely compatible with the 9602/9603 modem command set, though there are some differences and extensions specific to these products.

Yes. Cloudloop Data includes a “legacy RockBLOCK HTTP Post” option, so your existing integrations should continue to work without changes. That said, Cloudloop also supports a wide range of modern destination types – ideal if you’re using services like AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure – so it’s worth exploring those for even more flexibility.

Yes, it’s TTL level UART at the 16-pin header.

Yes, we offer a plastic mounting enclosure as an accessory for the SMA version. This enclosure is designed to securely hold the PCB in place, with integrated features such as screw holes for easy mounting, so you won’t need to develop a custom solution unless you prefer to.

No, the RockBLOCK 9704 does not integrate with the existing RockBLOCK admin dashboard. Instead, it’s managed through Cloudloop, our modern platform that provides all the same functionality and more.

You’ll still be able to activate units, manage delivery groups, and send mobile-terminated (MT) messages manually via the user interface. Cloudloop supports these features across all devices and transport types, offering a more flexible and scalable approach to device management.
